gpu_memory_free_mib_mean.aggregation: Take the mean free memory across reported devices in the rank.

gpu_memory_used_fraction_mean.aggregation: Calculate each device's used fraction including reserved capacity, then take the rank mean.

sm_active_fraction_mean.aggregation: Take the mean across reported devices in the rank.

dram_active_fraction_mean.aggregation: Take the mean across reported devices in the rank.
